english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for comprehending words, facts, or what someone means, including understanding someone's feelings or intentions.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for comprehending or understanding something.
This is the all-purpose choice for understanding or grasping an idea.
Use this when get means understand an idea, explanation, or joke.
Use this for understanding and sympathizing with someone's feelings or point of view, as in 我明白你.
Use this when appreciate means understanding or being fully aware of a situation or its importance.
Use this when “follow me” means understand what I am saying.
